title: Degree-zero continuity for stalkwise etale sections
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u+1 [def-pc-scheme], i : X.Opens -> X.Etale a functor [def-sc-zariski-site] [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] whose underlying scheme functor equals X.restrictFunctor, and x a point. There is an epimorphism-preserving functor H from abelian etale sheaves on X [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] to abelian etale sheaves on Spec(O_X,x), and a natural isomorphism from etaleObjectStalkSections X i x to H followed by evaluation at the terminal etale object of Spec(O_X,x). No henselian assumption is made.

source.place: Degree zero of Lemma 59.51.5 and proof steps (1)-(3), restricted to affine neighbourhoods; applied after restriction to i(top).

proof.text: Apply strictHenselian_stalkSections_comparison_functor to the actual local-scheme morphism X.fromSpecStalk x, obtaining H and its adjunction to the specified direct image. This witness is consumed in the theorem proof, never used to define arbitrary data.

The Mathlib theorem Functor.preservesEpimorphisms_of_adjunction gives epimorphism preservation: the adjunction hom bijection transports right cancellation of an epimorphism to right cancellation of its image.

Apply strictHenselian_stalkSections_comparison_iso with this same H and its adjunction. Its section comparison together with epimorphism preservation supplies the original existential conclusion unchanged.

proof_origin.note: Repair of the false arbitrary-H decomposition, separating inverse-image adjunction existence from degree-zero continuity.

mathlib_searches.query: Zariski stalk sections of an etale sheaf compare to sections on the spectrum of its local ring
mathlib_searches.results: Eight algebraic local-ring stalk identities; none supplies etale section continuity.
PreservesEpimorphisms.of_iso, preservesEpimorphisms_comp and preservation by left adjoints; no section comparison.
No section-continuity declaration in Mathlib. The existing EtaleCohomologyLocalRingColimit uses AddCommGrpCat above the site universe and higher-cohomology data, unlike the present section functor.

mathlib_searches.results: Second reading: only etale-locus and scheme-stalk identities, no sheaf section continuity comparison.
Second reading: evaluation comparisons and constant-sheaf adjunctions, no local-scheme continuity.

Second reading also searched both Lean roots: scheme-stalk limit available, local terminal-section surjectivity available, higher-cohomology continuity uses larger coefficients; no duplicate of this same-universe functor comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem strictHenselian_stalkSections_comparison
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}} (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    (hi_inclusion : i ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X = X.restrictFunctor) (x : X) :
    ∃ H : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⥤
        Sheaf (Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1},
      H.PreservesEpimorphisms ∧
        Nonempty (etaleObjectStalkSections X i x ≅
          H ⋙ (sheafSections (Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)).smallEtaleTopology
            AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 _))))
